name: Bug Fixes
description: Fixes bugs in the game: the crowd and announcers keep playing after a Road to the Show debut, changes you keep in the Road to the Show player editor are saved right away, a Road to the Show save is written as soon as you name it, and a new Road to the Show player is no longer saved half-made as "Joe Random". (No freeze before each pitch, finished tutorials, saved hub upgrades and kept custom cameras are built into Fastball 0.2.0 and later.)
